title: RCA: vehicle details, policy checks and fleet records
excerpt: RCA in Moldova: check vehicle information, official policy records, differences from CASCO and clear administration for company vehicles.

seo.title: RCA policy verification and fleet records Moldova | ING Broker
seo.description: Check RCA vehicle and policyholder details, validity, BNM registration, payment and issued documents. A practical verification guide for Moldovan fleets.
seo.keywords: RCA Moldova, RCA policy verification, motor third party liability, vehicle insurance documents, company RCA

content:
RCA is motor third-party liability insurance for harm caused to other people under the applicable framework and documents. It is not a policy for every expense involving your own car. Before comparing prices, check the vehicle, the person or company entering the contract, the period and the issued document. A data error can leave uncertainty in an apparently correct quotation.

This material helps drivers and fleet administrators in Moldova organize those checks. It introduces no new tariffs, claims deadlines or statutory limits. For individual circumstances, consult current BNM information and the insurer's documents. Insurance ING Broker SRL acts as a broker, helping explain options and records without deciding compensation in the insurer's place.

What does RCA address and what remains separate?

The main question is liability for harm caused to others through vehicle use, not recovery of every cost borne by the owner. Damage to your own car, roadside assistance, transported goods or people in the vehicle may involve other documents and conditions. Do not consider all these included because an offer uses the word motor.

Write down the actual need: RCA for road use, protection for your own vehicle, assistance following immobilization or another service. Describe different uses within a company's fleet. A clear list avoids comparing documents with different purposes. A product's presence in a catalogue does not establish that every person or use qualifies for every service.

Identify the vehicle to be insured precisely

Prepare the registration certificate and compare it with the application. Check the plate, vehicle identifier and relevant requested characteristics. Do not complete a field from memory when the document provides the answer. For company, leased or rented vehicles, request the records needed for the actual arrangement and confirm who enters into the contract.

For a recently purchased vehicle, do not assume all previous details remain suitable. Explain changes and ask which records need updating. Never edit a policy file yourself to change a name or plate. Keep the issuer's answer and compare the final version with current documents. Check before use, not only when a verification problem arises.

Individuals and companies have different records

The policyholder's details must reflect the actual circumstances. For a company, prepare its legal name and requested identifiers and appoint someone to check the quotation. Do not automatically substitute a director's or employee's personal details for the business. If the correct contracting party is unclear, request an explanation based on ownership or use rather than inventing a rule.

In a family, agree who keeps documents and tracks expiry. For a fleet, maintain a record for every vehicle, not just one payment total. Control access to documents and avoid public tables of personal information. Good administration does not change insurance conditions, but helps people notice differences between the request and the document received.

How do you check the period and start of validity?

Read the dates in both the quotation and the issued policy. Do not infer commencement solely from the day of payment or calculation. Where a policy should follow an existing one, compare periods and clarify any gap or overlap. A new application should not be assumed to protect an event that has already happened.

Companies can maintain a renewal calendar with alerts before expiry. Track vehicles temporarily moved to another workplace or replaced in operations in the same record. Another fleet vehicle's policy does not resolve the absence of the correct document. For changes in use or details, ask which checks are needed before reporting internally that documents are in order.

Verify RCA through the official source

BNM's RCA Data provides an instrument for checking motor insurance information. Use the official page and details of a vehicle you are entitled to check. Read the insurance type, period and issuer, not simply whether a result exists. An old insurance entry does not automatically establish the validity currently needed.

If the system and received policy disagree, keep the records and ask the issuer to clarify. Do not publish identity documents in an internet comment to obtain a check. Never give passwords or card information to someone promising to activate a policy. Resolve the question through official contacts without changing the issued document yourself.

Why is another driver's calculation not your quotation?

The premium is the amount paid for insurance. A calculation must use the relevant person or company and vehicle details. Do not copy another car's price or treat an online example as a confirmed tariff. Request an explanation and correction of inputs before concluding that a difference must be an error.

Check history and entered information through the appropriate sources and procedures. Where bonus-malus is discussed, clarify the applied class without assuming another person's result applies to you. This article promises no discount percentage. Compare proposals on the same basis and retain the calculation date: an old screenshot does not prove the price available at current issuance.

Check the document, not just a confirmation message

After ordering, make sure the actual document is available and readable. Check important details and the issuer's contacts. Keep payment confirmation separate from the policy so both can be found without searching a long message thread. For a fleet, connect every file to its vehicle and avoid giving all files the same name.

If payment is confirmed but the document is missing, request a status check. Do not repeat payment without establishing what happened to the first transaction. An order-processing message is not a verified policy for a colleague or driver. After a correction, identify the valid version and do not leave contradictory documents in current circulation.

If an accident occurs

People's safety and competent authorities' instructions take priority. For insurance matters, consult the issuer's current procedure and official guidance on documenting the case. A shortened social post cannot replace the conditions applying to your circumstances. This article does not determine fault or confirm payment of a particular compensation request.

Keep the timeline, necessary documents and communications. Avoid admissions or promises on behalf of other people or the insurer. Obtain appropriate legal assistance where needed. Medical information, identity documents and images of victims should not be sent through a general public form. Agree the necessary document list and transmission channel without collecting other people's information unnecessarily.

How does a fleet administrator work with the broker?

Prepare the current vehicle list, requested records and expiry calendar. Explain actual uses and changes since the previous year. Ask for observations to identify the specific vehicle and document concerned. A fleet discussion does not remove the need to check every policy. A discount discussed for voluntary insurance must not be treated as an automatic RCA reduction.

Maintain a register of requests, calculations and received documents with clear statuses: requested, calculated, paid, issued and verified. They are not interchangeable. The broker can help explain discrepancies and transmit information through the agreed process, but does not replace the insurer's claims decision. Do not ask colleagues to close an issue merely because someone has sent a message.

An illustrative administrative check

A company buys a vehicle to replace one in its fleet. The administrator finds a policy for the old plate copied into the new folder. This example is illustrative. It establishes neither the existence nor absence of insurance for any real vehicle and does not describe an ING Broker client's case.

Instead of assuming the folder change resolves the documents, the administrator checks records, the application and official information. The issuer is asked to clarify, and the calendar is updated after the appropriate document arrives. The lesson is practical: internal records must follow the actual vehicle and policy. A filename or a colleague's verbal assurance is insufficient for a final check.

A two-stage check can reduce administrative errors

One person can prepare information and another compare the final document with vehicle records. This is an organizational recommendation for businesses managing several vehicles, not a universal insurance condition. Independent checking is useful when plates or models are similar. Record the result without unnecessary copying of personal data. Mark a discrepancy unresolved until the issuer replies, not verified merely because the premium has been paid.

Frequently asked questions about motor liability

Can RCA and CASCO replace each other?

Do not treat them as equivalent documents. They address different needs. Read each policy's conditions and ask about the situations that concern you rather than inferring protection from the general name motor insurance.

Can I check policy information online?

Yes. BNM's official RCA Data portal provides verification tools. Compare results with your documents and ask about discrepancies rather than choosing one version without confirmation.

What should I do about a policy error?

Contact the issuer and explain the difference from the correct records. Do not edit the file yourself. Check the corrected document and keep the reply identifying which version should be used.

Is a displayed price already a valid policy?

No. Calculation, payment and issuance are distinct stages. Check the final document and period. If a stage is unclear, seek confirmation before considering the process complete.
